title: Spacetime Curvature & Geodesics
subtitle: Einstein Field Equations & Gravitational Lensing Deflection
description: 3D Flamm's paraboloid embedding visualization of curved 4D spacetime around a massive central body. Demonstrates Schwarzschild metric curvature funneling, stable orbital geodesics, and gravitational light ray deflection angles (Δφ ≈ 4GM/c²b).
formulaCompact: z(r) = 2 * Math.sqrt(rs * (r - rs)); defAngle = (4 * GM) / (c^2 * b);
